map.癫痫 ILAE 发作分类器 使用指南: Epilepsy ILAE Seizure Classifier User Guide
map.基于国际抗癫痫联盟(ILAE)2017年分类框架，逐级确定癫痫发作分类: Based on the 2017 classification framework of the International League Against Epilepsy (ILAE), determine the seizure classification step by step
map.按起病与意识进行发作类型分类。: Classify the seizure type by onset and awareness.
map.病因（结构性/遗传/免疫/代谢）导向检查。: Etiology (structural / genetic / immune / metabolic) guides the workup.
map.：局灶性运动发作、意识受损、结构性病因：分类为局灶性运动发作（意识受损），建议头: : Focal motor seizure, impaired awareness, structural etiology: classified as a focal motor seizure with impaired awareness; a 3T cranial MRI plus thin-slice hippocampal imaging is recommended to look for a resectable lesion.
map.：全面性非运动、失神：全面性失神发作，建议EEG 与遗传咨询。: : Generalized non-motor, absence: a generalized absence seizure; EEG and genetic counseling are recommended.
map.先看起局灶/全面，再看意识是否受损与发作表现。: First determine focal versus generalized onset, then check whether awareness is impaired and what the seizure looks like.
map.结构性病完善影像，免疫性查抗体，代谢性纠紊乱，遗传性做基因。: For structural causes complete the imaging, for immune causes check antibodies, for metabolic causes correct the disorder, and for genetic causes do genetic testing.
